page.overview:
What is The Other New Song?

The Other New Song is a song that Metallica played during the Escape from the Studio '06 and the Sick of the Studio '07 tour.

See the vultures come See the vultures come for me Falling from the sun Falling down to wait for me

Just sit and stare Waiting till I hit the ground Feel the vultures tear Feel the vultures tear at flesh

Vulture it's time to say Pick the bone until you're prey Fall below and in between Pick the bone until you're prey
